content: 1. A servomechanism, commonly referred to as a servo, is a device that utilizes feedback to control and regulate a specific operation or process. 2. A servo drive is a specialized type of electric amplifier designed to supply power to electric servo motors. 3. Tom Servo is a fictional character featured in the television series Mystery Science Theater 3000. 4. SERVO Magazine is a monthly publication dedicated to topics in robotics. 5. In the Star Trek episode Assignment: Earth, a multipurpose tool used by the character Gary Seven is referred to as a servo. 6. Servotronic refers to a type of power steering system that adjusts its assistance based on the vehicle's speed. 7. In Australian slang, the term servo is commonly used to describe a petrol station. 8. Servo is a character from the television series Superhuman Samurai Syber-Squad. 9. In the computer game The Sims: Livin' Large, Servo is a non-playable character. 10. In the expansion pack The Sims 2: Open for Business, Servo is introduced as a playable character. 11. Servo is the title of a song by the band The Brian Jonestown Massacre, featured on their album Give It Back..
